## Report

Extracted my 7 components from `cart/hmsc-workspace-mock/index.tsx`, each verbatim into its own file under `cart/editor/shell/`, one `export default function` per file. No barrel, no sub-component splits were needed (none of these components contained nested helper sub-components). index.tsx, the data/, workspace.cls.ts, and route files were not touched.

Import wiring used in every file: `Icon` from `'../../../runtime/icons/Icon'`, `{ C, accentFor }` from `'../workspace.cls'`, data from `'../data/<file>'`. Bundle-checked Chrome, BuildDock, BuildJournalDialog — all exit 0, clean.

Files + props interfaces (for the AppFrame composition root):

- `cart/editor/shell/Chrome.tsx`
  `props: { state: MockState; activeCommand: Command; onMenu: (menu: Menu) => void; onCommand: (id: string, source: string) => void; onUndo: () => void; onRedo: () => void }`
  Data: `activeMenuFor`, `MENUS` (`../data/commands`); types `Command, Menu, MockState` (`../data/types`).

- `cart/editor/shell/DropdownMenu.tsx`
  `{ state: MockState; onCommand: (id: string, source: string) => void }`
  Data: `COMMANDS`, `MENU_DROPDOWN_WIDTH`, `menuDropdownLeft` (`../data/commands`).

- `cart/editor/shell/ContextMenu.tsx`
  `{ state: MockState; onCommand: (id: string, source: string) => void }`
  Data: `COMMANDS`, `commandById` (`../data/commands`).

- `cart/editor/shell/LeftRail.tsx`
  `{ state: MockState; onDomain: (domain: string) => void }`
  Data: `DOMAINS` (`../data/content`).

- `cart/editor/shell/BuildDock.tsx`
  `{ state: MockState; onBuild: () => void; onEventbus: () => void }`
  Data: `ACTIVE_BUILD`, `BUILD_NOTES` (`../data/journal`); `editTelemetry`, `formatMs` (`../data/telemetry`).

- `cart/editor/shell/EventBusPopover.tsx`
  `{ state: MockState; onClose: () => void }`
  Data: `editTelemetry`, `formatMs` (`../data/telemetry`).

- `cart/editor/shell/BuildJournalDialog.tsx`
  `{ onClose: () => void }`
  Data: `ACTIVE_BUILD`, `BUILD_NOTES`, `BUILD_THREADS` (`../data/journal`). No `state` prop.

Inline styles preserved exactly where the mock used them for computed values: Chrome (none), DropdownMenu (`{ left: menuDropdownLeft(...), width: MENU_DROPDOWN_WIDTH }`), EventBusPopover sparkline cells (computed `height`/`backgroundColor`), BuildJournalDialog accent bar (`{ backgroundColor: accentFor(...) }`). No new inline styles invented; classifier usage left intact.

Note: EventBusPopover and BuildJournalDialog reference `C.HW_HistoryMeta`, `C.HW_HistoryTitle`, `C.HW_ReadValue` — these classifier members are used in the mock too (and weren't in the lines 1-247 page of workspace.cls.ts I read). esbuild doesn't typecheck so the bundle is clean; the composition root should confirm those three classifiers exist in `workspace.cls.ts` if strict TS typecheck is ever run.</result>
